negative.text:
SBAR handover 03:10
S: dyspnea. B: lung ca on chemo. A: Hb 'pending' - 8.4 g/dL is from the old tube, not yet verified by lab. R: recheck at 06:00.
혈소판: 검체 응고로 판독 불가 (기계 표시값 62 x10^3/uL, 보고하지 않음)
Lab comment: Creatinine - TNP (test not performed) 1.8 mg/dL printed from analyzer error log only.
Preliminary: ANC 0.4 x10^9/L, awaiting manual differential confirmation, do not act on this.
ECOG: 미평가 (환자 의식저하로 평가 불가) / 이전 기록상 2
Albumin - cancelled by physician, 2.1 g/dL was entered in error and struck through.
AST: unable to report, hemolysis 3+. 310 U/L is an instrument flag only.
나이: 확인 불가 - 신분증 미지참, 보호자 말로는 대략 71세 정도라고만 함 (미확인)
INR: sample rejected by lab, 4.8 shown on analyzer but not released.
총 빌리루빈: 결과 보류, 임시값 3.2 mg/dL (검증 전)
INR not done today; last year's was 1.0 according to the old chart.
WBC 검사 미시행. 차트에 6800/uL 라고 적혀있는 건 2019년 입원 때 값임.
Transfer letter: Hb not drawn this morning (patient refused). The 11.5 g/dL quoted in the letter is dated three months ago.
혈소판 오늘 안 나갔음. 그저께 값 98 참고만 하세요 - 오늘 수치 아님.
Creatinine was not measured at our hospital; the outside clinic reportedly had 0.8 mg/dL but no date or report was attached.
ECOG not documented at this visit; trial screening form came pre-filled with 1 from the template.
Albumin: N/D. (Note: 3.9 g/dL from 2022 admission, kept for trend only.)
ANC not performed due to machine fault; nurse wrote 1.5 on the whiteboard from the last cycle.
빌리루빈 미검 - 지난 항암 때 1.4 mg/dL 였음 (이번 주기 검사 없음)
Insurance form, section 4: AST not run this episode. The field is auto-copied 45 U/L from the previous claim.
Donor work-up note: brother's hemoglobin 14.1 g/dL (donor), recipient not yet tested.
환자 일기: 엄마 혈소판이 낮아서 걱정이다. 엄마 수치가 88 이라고 했다.
Same ward, bed 4 (not our patient): creatinine 3.4 mg/dL, nephrology consulted.
Tumour board minutes: the case discussed before ours had ANC 0.6 x10^9/L; ours not yet available.
보호자(아내) 나이 58세. 환자 기록은 별도 확인 필요.
Staff chat 22:41 Dr. Kim: sorry, wrong patient! INR 2.9 was Mr. Park's, not hers.
Translated record (from Vietnamese): the newborn son's total bilirubin 12 mg/dL, phototherapy started. Mother's labs not attached.
Family history: father had albumin 2.5 g/dL near the end of his illness. Patient's own albumin not drawn.
Trial abstract: average hemoglobin in the comparator arm was 10.3 g/dL; this patient is not yet randomized.
Pharmacy note: prior patient of same name (different DOB) had AST 210 U/L; chart merge error flagged, values do not belong to this patient.
HbA1c 8.2 % (diabetes follow-up); CBC not sent.
직접 빌리루빈 2.4 mg/dL (총 빌리루빈은 기재 없음)
Liver panel excerpt: ALT 120 U/L; AST line not listed in this fax.
Urine creatinine 140 mg/dL (spot urine for protein ratio); serum not drawn.
CSF albumin 30 mg/dL, lumbar puncture note; serum albumin unknown.
Absolute lymphocyte count 1.2 x10^9/L, total WBC not transcribed.
PT 13.5 sec reported; INR line missing from the printout.
Platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio 210 calculated by research fellow for prognostic score.
Karnofsky 80 recorded by physiotherapy; no ECOG score in the notes.
X-ray: bone age 12 years, skeletal assessment only; chronological age not stated in this report.
Hb 10 g/dL expected after transfusion; recheck ordered, result pending.
혈소판 검사 의뢰함, 결과 대기중. 70 정도 예상이라고 들음.
Creatinine to be drawn at 14:00; target below 1.5 mg/dL before cisplatin is released.
ANC send-out, courier picked up, ETA 48h; ward estimate roughly 0.8 x10^9/L.
Bilirubin tube in analyzer, will update. 2.0 mg/dL is just what the registrar guessed.
ECOG 재평가 예정 (다음 외래 3주 후). 현재 점수 보류, 1 일 것으로 추정.
INR queued. Provisional point-of-care 1.9, lab venous confirmation outstanding.
WBC 12.0 given verbally by phone; written report not yet received, unverified.
Diary: they took blood for albumin this morning. Doctor said maybe 3.0, still waiting for the real number.
AST scheduled for tomorrow; if above 100 U/L hold the drug.
Hemolyzed sample, Hb 7.9 g/dL invalid, recollect.
혈소판 응집(clumping)으로 38 - 부정확한 값, 구연산 튜브로 재검 요청함.
Creatinine 4.1 mg/dL drawn from an IV line contaminated with fluids - discard, redraw ordered.
ANC 0.2 x10^9/L from a sample more than 24h old; lab rejected it, new draw requested.
INR 6.0 - tube underfilled, citrate ratio wrong, result invalid, repeat needed.
지방혈증 검체, 총빌리루빈 5.1 mg/dL 간섭으로 보고 불가, 재채혈 예정.
AST 880 U/L on a hemolyzed tube; result suppressed pending new sample.
Albumin 1.9 g/dL - sample drawn above the running infusion, diluted, disregard and redraw.
WBC 31 x10^9/L analyzer flag, smear review shows platelet clumps artefact; the value is invalid.
ECOG 4 recorded while patient sedated after the procedure; invalid, reassess when awake.
No evidence of anemia. Normal hemoglobin range 12-16 g/dL per lab reference.
혈소판감소증 없음 (정상범위 150-400), 이번 입원 중 검사는 시행하지 않음.
Renal function felt not impaired clinically; reference creatinine up to 1.2 mg/dL; no sample taken.
No neutropenia suspected (normal ANC above 1.5), exact value not recorded.
No jaundice on exam; normal bilirubin below 1.2 mg/dL; not checked this week.
No edema, no hypoalbuminaemia expected; albumin 3.5-5.0 g/dL is the lab's range, patient not tested.
No leukocytosis or fever. WBC normal limits 4-10 x10^9/L, differential not ordered.
출혈 소견 없음. 정상 INR 범위 0.8-1.2, 오늘 미측정.
No hepatic injury suspected, AST upper limit of normal 40 U/L, not tested this admission.
No functional decline reported. Form legend: ECOG 0 = fully active; physician has not scored the patient yet.

positive.text: Final report: hemoglobin 10.2 g/dL (collected 07:05, verified by lab).
결과 확정 - 혈소판 143 x10^3/uL, 어제와 큰 변화 없음.
Corrected result: creatinine 1.1 mg/dL after re-verification by the lab director.
Verified: ANC 2.3 x10^9/L. Proceed with cycle 4.
ECOG 수행도 1로 평가함 (외래 진료 중 직접 확인).
Result released 09:12: albumin 3.6 g/dL.
Status: final. AST 28 U/L.
Age confirmed against ID card: 64 years old.
INR 1.2 (확정, 오늘 오전 채혈)
Completed: total bilirubin 0.7 mg/dL, no hemolysis noted.
CT not done today; creatinine 0.9 mg/dL this morning clears her for contrast next week.
ECG 미시행. 혈색소는 오늘 채혈해서 12.8 g/dL.
Bone marrow biopsy not performed; platelets 210 x10^9/L on today's CBC.
Urine culture not sent. WBC 5.4 x10^9/L on today's CBC.
PET 못 찍음 (예약 변경됨). 알부민 4.0 g/dL 오늘 확인.
Pulmonary function test not done. ECOG 1 assessed in clinic today.
Repeat INR was not needed since the first draw was fine: INR 1.0.
G-CSF 투약 안 함 (보류). ANC 1.9 x10^9/L 금일 결과.
MRI not performed today; AST 33 U/L this morning.
No transfusion given. Total bilirubin 0.5 mg/dL this morning.
Brother (donor) Hb 14.1 g/dL; the patient's own hemoglobin is 9.8 g/dL.
어머니도 당뇨가 있으나, 환자 본인의 크레아티닌은 1.0 mg/dL.
Roommate's WBC is high; ours (the patient) is 7.2 x10^9/L.
Wife says she is 55, but the patient himself is 68 years old per registration.
Tumour board: our patient ECOG 2 per oncology; the neighbouring case (ECOG 0) is irrelevant here.
Chat - Dr Lee: Mr. Cho in bed 12 has INR 1.1. Ignore the 3.0, that was bed 13.
자녀 유전검사는 정상. 환자 본인 총빌리루빈 0.9 mg/dL.
Her sister had low platelets, but the patient's own platelet count is 187 x10^9/L today.
Translated record: Mrs. Tanaka's (the patient) albumin 3.3 g/dL; her husband's was 4.1 on his visit.
Pharmacy: duplicate-name flag resolved by DOB; this patient's AST is 41 U/L.
HbA1c 6.1 %, hemoglobin 11.9 g/dL on the same draw.
ALT 55 U/L, AST 38 U/L, both from today's liver panel.
직접 빌리루빈 0.2, 총 빌리루빈 0.8 mg/dL.
Urine creatinine 140 mg/dL (spot); serum creatinine 1.3 mg/dL.
Ferritin 450 ng/mL; Hb 10.6 g/dL, iron studies ordered.
Lymphocytes 1.1 x10^9/L; WBC 4.9 x10^9/L total.
PT 12.8 sec, INR 1.1 on warfarin check.
Karnofsky 90 by physio; oncologist scored ECOG 0.
LDH 600 U/L; albumin 3.8 g/dL.
CRP 5 mg/L; platelets 256 x10^9/L.
Tumor markers pending; Hb 11.0 g/dL already resulted.
혈액배양 결과 대기 중. 혈소판 165 x10^3/uL 확정.
Genomic panel awaited; creatinine 0.8 mg/dL is final.
Blood group still pending, ANC 3.1 x10^9/L today, final.
Cortisol pending. Total bilirubin 0.6 mg/dL resulted.
MRI scheduled next week; ECOG 1 today.
Troponin pending, INR 1.0 final.
Culture ongoing; WBC 8.3 x10^9/L resulted.
다음 알부민 검사는 2주 후 예정, 오늘 알부민은 3.5 g/dL.
Lipase pending; AST 22 U/L verified.
First tube hemolysed (Hb 7.9 discarded); recollection gave Hb 10.4 g/dL, valid.
재채혈 시행: 혈소판 112 x10^3/uL (구연산 튜브, 응집 없음).
Redrawn from the opposite arm: creatinine 1.0 mg/dL.
Earlier ANC was invalid due to sample age; fresh sample ANC 1.6 x10^9/L.
INR repeated with proper tube fill: 1.3.
지방혈증 검체는 폐기, 재검 총빌리루빈 1.1 mg/dL.
AST repeat on a non-hemolysed tube: 45 U/L.
Albumin 3.1 g/dL on clean redraw, first one was diluted.
WBC after smear review confirmed 5.9 x10^9/L.
ECOG 2 reassessed once the patient was awake and alert.
No anemia. Hb 13.5 g/dL.
혈소판 감소 없음, 혈소판 231 x10^3/uL 로 정상.
No renal impairment: creatinine 0.7 mg/dL.
호중구감소증 없음. ANC 4.2 x10^9/L.
No jaundice, total bilirubin 0.4 mg/dL.
No edema; albumin 4.3 g/dL, normal.
No signs of infection; WBC 6.1 x10^9/L.
출혈 소견 없음, INR 1.0 (정상).
No liver injury, AST 19 U/L.
Denies fatigue, no functional limits: ECOG 0 assessed by physician today.
